annotations.title: Read a Bible passage in the Shprd reader

description: Reads a Bible passage or chapter from the World English Bible. Use this when the user asks to read, open, show or look up a passage, for example "read Romans 8", "open Matthew 9" or "show me Psalm 23". In ChatGPT the passage appears in a reader card with previous and next chapter buttons and the source credit, and only the reference and credit are returned as text. In other clients it returns the passage text and credit, and a client that can draw the card shows it too. It does not search by words.

reference.description: Book, chapter and optional verses, e.g. "John 3:16-18", "Psalm 23", "Romans 8:28-9:3", "Jude 5".
